findings: The prescribed Eulerian material profiles, negligible charge convection and zero-mean-flow mechanical reaction give a closed electrical and mechanical model.
The spectral potential signs enforce div(sigma E)=0 with E=mean(E)-grad(phi). For sigma proportional to epsilon, div(epsilon E)=0 identically and the shortcut equals the physical force.

The electric body force rho_free E minus one-half E squared times grad(epsilon) equals div[epsilon(E tensor E - E squared I/2)] for the specified curl-free field. Electrostriction is an absorbed pressure term.

The independent reference solves finite-volume face currents and differentiates Maxwell stress on staggered locations; it does not copy the oracle body-force expression. Forward-gradient/backward-divergence projection and half-cell Fourier detector offsets are consistent.
The homogeneous velocity is fixed by the specified mechanical reaction. Removing its Fourier mode is valid even when the approximate DEP-only force has a nonzero mean.
